findings.source_quote: ἡ δὲ τοῦ κύτους ἔνδοθεν γόνιμος ὑπολειφθεῖσα ὕλη, ὡς ἐν πολλῷ τῷ χρόνῳ ὑποκειμένης ἕως φυσικῆς ὑποζέουσα ἡ θερμότης, τὰς πάντων διέκρινεν οὐσίας.
findings.english_quote: But as for the fertile matter left behind inside the shell, as it lay beneath for a long time, [ἕως φυσικῆς], the heat simmering underneath separated the substances of all things.
findings.issue: The surviving words ἕως φυσικῆς remain untranslated. Reading ὑποκειμένης as referring to the preceding matter is defensible, but it does not resolve these words: temporal ἕως lacks a supported continuation, while φυσικῆς lacks a sufficiently identifiable noun or substantive sense in this construction. The surrounding account of physical separation does not establish the missing grammatical relationship. The note honestly discloses this limitation, but reproducing Greek in brackets does not provide English coverage of its meaning. This is an unresolved meaning problem in the image-checked printed reading, not an established OCR error or a printed lacuna. The remaining clauses, names, and images are defensibly represented.
findings.suggested_revision: Supply a defensible analysis of the unchanged ἕως φυσικῆς, identifying the function of ἕως, the referent or substantive meaning of φυσικῆς, and their relationship to the surrounding construction, followed by corresponding English wording and disclosure of material alternatives. Until such an analysis is available, retain the explicit unresolved wording and blocked status. Any conjectural correction must be distinguished from the supplied reading; it cannot count as a translation of the unchanged selected edition. Revised English requires fresh review.
